subject.title: Feature request: first-class .env / environment-backed secret config UX

question: What SecretRef source metadata may Control UI safely show for env-backed secrets: source category only, env variable name, provider alias, and/or resolved status?
rationale: The implementation is straightforward only after maintainers decide which secret-source details are safe to disclose and edit in a browser UI.

options.title: Conservative source-aware UI
options.body: Show masked values with source category and resolved/unresolved state, but hide exact env variable names unless the user explicitly reveals or edits that field.

options.title: Full env identity display
options.body: Show exact env variable names and provider aliases by default, improving clarity but exposing more operator topology in Control UI.

options.title: Defer source metadata
options.body: Keep the read-only generic SecretRef behavior until a broader secrets UX/security model is designed.

recommendation.title: Conservative source-aware UI
recommendation.body: Show masked values with source category and resolved/unresolved state, but hide exact env variable names unless the user explicitly reveals or edits that field.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Control UI/config history and issue timeline mentions make this the best available routing candidate for the product/security boundary decision.
